visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a middle-aged male host with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black collared shirt. He stands against a blurred background depicting a bowl of braised pork rice. He holds a small black remote control in his right hand and gestures expressively while speaking. (2) A brief transition shows a blue spherical energy animation against a dark cosmic background, representing particle scattering. (3) The camera returns to the host at eye level, who continues his explanation with animated facial expressions and hand gestures. (4) An animation of a swirling white galaxy or nebula appears, illustrating the concept of dark matter accumulation at a planetary core. (5) A scientific graph with green and blue plotted lines and mathematical labels like 'Fermionic Dark Matter' is displayed full-screen, with the host appearing in a small inset circle at the bottom right. (6) The host returns to full screen, pointing his clicker and using open-palm gestures to conclude his explanation of the scientific method. (7) Another technical graph showing planetary mass thresholds is shown briefly before returning to the host's final remarks.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 加入泛糰會員 一起撐開腦洞. [Variety]: 為找暗物質 獻祭一整顆行星!. [Subtitle]: 科學家可能找到了找暗物質的終極方法. (2) [Subtitle]: 但需要先犧牲... 一整顆行星. (3) [Subtitle]: 這篇發表在《物理評論D》上的論文. (4) [Subtitle]: 乍聽之下是弗力札的科展作品. (5) [Subtitle]: 而是加州大學河濱分校的兩名科學家提出的. (6) [Subtitle]: 科學家為什麼會想到用行星呢?. (7) [Subtitle]: 因為在地球上蓋探測器來找「超重暗物質」. (8) [Subtitle]: 粒子飛來的機率太低. (9) [Subtitle]: 不如去找一個宇宙級的超大號陷阱. (10) [Subtitle]: 是一個巨大、氣態、太陽系外的行星. (11) [Subtitle]: 它夠大、夠冷，而且數量超多. (12) [Subtitle]: 建立了一套物理模型來計算可行性. (13) [Subtitle]: 第一步是「捕獲」. (14) [Subtitle]: 第二步是「積累」. (15) [Subtitle]: 第三步是「塌縮」. (16) [Subtitle]: 瞬間塌縮成一個微型黑洞. (17) [Subtitle]: 當初形成它的暗物質有多重. (18) [Subtitle]: 劇本一是行星吞噬. (19) [Subtitle]: 劇本二是霍金輻射. (20) [Subtitle]: 我們只要當個稱職的狗仔.
